It is recorded as `5883360525` on #4356, #10974 and #10979, and it unblocks all three.

## ④ Notes

- **Writes.** They go through the fleet-write relay as `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.
- **Tier.** This seat is served below `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (objectstack `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` at `df3ba16`), so every contract review runs as an isolated at-tier subagent.
- **`dispatch-gates` does not derive objectui.** Its `--tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` half answers from path globs; the gate families are hand-derived from objectui's own manifests and workflows, and the dev re-derives them against the actual diff.
- **Spec Main Shape Gate.** It compiles against objectstack `main`, not the pin.
